He says they must recover an old treasure but withholds practical details. Sen expects manipulation and danger, while Li Yi Nuo gradually becomes more cooperative with him. Their destination proves to be a sacred temple-city surrounded by an enormous horde of ghosts and devilish creatures. Believing Laughing River wants him to steal from holy ruins and seeing no survivable route through the horde, Sen refuses to continue.

Laughing River admits that foxes cannot enter the temple-city and that he brought Li Yi Nuo partly to make Sen less willing to walk away. When both humans still try to leave, he reveals that he is dying. Laughing River says he gained a ninth tail and should have ascended long ago, but delayed until he lost the strength to complete the passage. A treasure with time-space affinity inside the ruins may restore his chance. Sen personally examines him and confirms widespread decay, though not how much time remains. Li Yi Nuo refuses to be sent away despite lacking battlefield experience, and Sen rejects Laughing River's suggestion that killing her would simplify matters. The group studies the horde and concludes that direct battle and ordinary stealth are both unworkable. Li Yi Nuo identifies the need for a distraction, and Sen designs a vast formation intended to bombard one side of the horde long enough to open a route. Escape remains a separate problem. While placing the first section of formation flags, Sen is approached by a black-robed stranger who can evade his senses. The stranger recognizes Laughing River as a nine-tailed liar and tells Sen to let him die.

The stranger is a fox infiltrator intent on preventing Laughing River from obtaining the treasure. Sen learns to counter the attacker's layered illusions, but the fox drugs him, wounds Laughing River, and abducts Li Yi Nuo. Laughing River identifies the attacker as his descendant Misty Peak. Sen declares that the murder attempt and abduction exceed the favor he owed, then sets new terms: Laughing River must investigate whether Falling Leaf can ever regain or freely change her panther form. As Sen prepares two formation routes and a remotely triggered escape option, Misty Peak confronts him and confirms Li Yi Nuo is alive. She claims Laughing River summoned the continent's fox clans to a gathering near the Mountains of Sorrow, where hundreds were massacred, including her father. Since Laughing River was believed to be the only survivor, she regards him as the betrayer. Sen refuses to accept inherited accusation as proof and points out that Misty Peak herself would demand a chance to answer such a charge. She agrees to provide her full account and hear Laughing River's response. The hostage gives her little leverage because Sen will not surrender his judgment or the mission merely to recover Li Yi Nuo.

Laughing River confirms that he called the fatal fox gathering but denies betraying anyone. He says he rescued about a dozen foxes and withdrew afterward from guilt and grief, leaving the origin of the accusation unresolved. After initially neglecting the search because he dislikes Li Yi Nuo, he captures Misty Peak and confronts her privately. Sen refuses to mediate their family and political dispute. While they talk, he practices his weapons and maintains that he will offer shelter but take no responsibility for fox affairs. His plan to slow his cultivation then fails abruptly when a massive flow of heavenly qi forces another core layer to form. Sen strengthens two internal qi structures and reforges his body, but the energy continues beyond his control. An inaccessible inner gate finally opens and drains the excess somewhere connected to his soul. No expected tribulation follows. Sen wakes with denser qi, a larger core and dantian, and thousands of divine-qi points embedded in his skin. Laughing River judges that he has jumped from middle to late core formation and should not have survived the process. Sen can hide the visible glow, but neither he nor the fox understands its purpose, and Sen cannot reopen the inner channel.

Sen tests the strength and speed gained from his forced advancement and finds that even ordinary movement now requires restraint. Near the ruins, he negotiates a limited peace with the local spider matriarch, who permits his work while her brood watches. Sen later saves one of those watchers from a fire eagle. The spider begins guarding his shelter, apparently accepting a personal debt despite fearing him. Misty Peak asks to join the ruins expedition. Sen agrees only if Laughing River permits it, she can independently cross the anti-fox barrier, and she accepts responsibility for her own survival. Laughing River gives permission, while Misty Peak releases Li Yi Nuo from captivity. Sen completes and tests paired fire and lightning formations meant to pull part of the horde away from their chosen approach. The spider watcher stays beside him throughout the work, and the wider brood's surveillance becomes less tense. Sen still expects a fight because the distraction cannot draw every enemy away. After warning Li Yi Nuo, Misty Peak, and Laughing River that further personal conflict will make him abandon the plan, he finishes the final adjustments. The attempt to enter the ruins is set for dawn.

At dawn, Sen activates the fire and lightning formations while Laughing River adds an illusory army. Li Yi Nuo remains behind, but the saved spider unexpectedly follows Sen and Misty Peak toward the thinning edge of the horde. A spirit tries to possess Sen, and the divine qi in his skin destroys it. Rather than unleash an attack that might damage the sacred city, Sen spreads Heaven's Shadow through part of the horde, driving enemies into terror and conflict with one another. He then uses divine qi, lightning, and wind to force open a route. Sen, Misty Peak, and the spider cross the protective barrier, where a bell-like effect ends the immediate pursuit and strips away Misty Peak's human disguise. The city within is intact yet deliberately empty, with homes and durable possessions left behind. Their objective remains the spatial treasure Laughing River needs, and the central temple appears the likeliest location. However, a planted marker proves that the party's seemingly direct movement is being redirected without any detectable illusion. From above, Sen sees that the city is much larger than it appeared and that their route traces a deliberate pattern. He identifies the entire city as a mandala that has trapped them.

The sun does not move inside the ruins, and every attempt to retreat, fly directly to the temple, or escape the mandala returns the group to its imposed route. As they proceed, each traveller enters a separate trial. Sen's endless mountain ascent forces him to confront his regrets and accept that compassion and ruthlessness are both genuine parts of him. At the temple he meets an ancient caretaker, who explains that the city's defenses were designed to test Laughing River's readiness to ascend. The caretaker gives Sen the spatial treasure. On another path, the spider meets a transcendent matriarch, who grants him a humanoid form and the name Glimmer of Night so he can communicate. She directs him to travel with Sen for centuries. Misty Peak reports a similar instruction from fox ancestors. The caretaker says the absent inhabitants will eventually return and that the surrounding horde is contained because destroying it would cause equivalent evil to emerge elsewhere. The three travellers complete the mandala, but no one can determine how much outside time has passed. At the barrier, Sen discovers his remote formation trigger no longer works. Glimmer instead learns to crack beast cores so they detonate when thrown. The group prepares these as distractions, and Sen crosses the barrier first to begin their escape.

Sen opens the escape with Heaven's Shadow, cracked beast cores, darkness, lightning, and divine qi. Misty Peak warns Laughing River while Glimmer joins the bombardment. The horde has anticipated their exit, and an intelligent red-eyed devil attacks Sen with a spear. It is stronger than him and repeatedly drives devilish qi into severe chest wounds. Sen destroys part of its weapon and removes part of one arm, but he is blinded, deafened in one ear, poisoned, and eventually impaled. As the horde closes around him, he feeds divine qi into a damaged Stormhawk core. The devil's strike triggers a violent ground-level storm resembling a tribulation, scattering the horde. Glimmer rescues the incapacitated Sen, and Misty Peak guides the retreat to the gale house. After resting, Sen improvises a divine-qi elixir to purge the devilish corruption. The treatment nearly kills him and damages the shelter, but it removes the hostile qi and repairs his injuries. Once recovered, Sen confirms Glimmer still intends to travel with him and allows Misty Peak to accompany Laughing River's route only. Sen and Laughing River search the battlefield but find no body belonging to the red-eyed devil, leaving its survival unresolved.

Li Yi Nuo leaves the group near the Vermilion Blade Sect and reports her defeat, capture, the ruins expedition, Sen's battle with the horde, and his survival of the divine-qi elixir. She delivers Sen's elixirs and his introduction to Jaw-Long. Recognizing Sen's connections to Jaw-Long and Caihong, her master accepts the peace offering and ends the sect's pursuit of Judgment's Gale. Sen later leaves Misty Peak and Laughing River near Falling Leaf's destination but holds the spatial treasure until the fox teaches Falling Leaf to change form. Travelling with Glimmer, Sen senses an urgent call through a qi imprint on a necklace he once made for a village girl. They find her village burned and follow the surviving captives to a remote encampment. Sen kills the armed attackers and their leader but spares some others, while Glimmer protects the prisoners. They free the villagers and return recovered wealth to a surviving elder. The girl repeatedly leaves a resettlement village to find Sen, so he accepts immediate responsibility for her. Sen and Glimmer carry her through the wilds to the nascent-soul cultivator's domain. The cultivator grants her temporary refuge alongside Sen, Glimmer, and Falling Leaf, while Sen continues seeking a permanent home for her.

characters.description: A core-stage cultivator, alchemist and body cultivator who heads a young sect and has, almost by accident, become the master of a fast-growing town. He is the adoptive father of a small girl named Ai and is bringing a group of rescued villagers back to his town as a spirit beast war looms. He dislikes the titles people give him and feels uneasy about becoming a ruler.
characters.name: Sen

characters.description: Sen's young daughter, who calls him Papa. She arrives at the town riding a young feng huang that has attached itself to her, and she relays the bird's name to the adults. Her safety and future are the center of Sen's concerns.
characters.name: Ai

characters.description: A young feng huang that has bonded with Ai and lets her ride it. Uncle Kho believed the species had died out. It is not yet fully grown but carries strong fire chi, has silver eyes, and calls Sen the oxen friend, which hints that the spirit oxen may have sent it.
characters.name: The feng huang

characters.description: Sen's trusted companion and ally. When the story opens she is away from the town, trying to negotiate with rogue spirit beasts who refuse to follow the Beast King, and Sen asks after her as soon as he returns.
characters.name: Falling Leaf

characters.description: A nascent soul cultivator in Sen's inner circle who conceals the true extent of his strength from outsiders, a secret Sen intends to protect. He is knowledgeable about rare creatures and recognizes the feng huang as something he had thought extinct.
characters.name: Uncle Kho

characters.description: The ruler of the spirit beasts and the power behind the coming war. Some rogue beasts refuse to follow him, and Falling Leaf has been meeting with them.
characters.name: The Beast King

characters.description: A woman cultivator who gathers plants for alchemy and led the expedition connected to the rescued villagers. She is badly frightened by the feng huang when it lands among them.
characters.name: The plant-gathering cultivator

characters.description: Someone Sen counts among the few people he genuinely looks forward to seeing when he returns to his town.
characters.name: Glimmer of Night

characters.description: A nascent soul cultivator who lives in a domain near Sen's town, having moved out there to get away from crowds. Sen expects her to be unhappy that the town is swelling toward the size of a city.
characters.name: Fu Ru Lan

characters.description: An ancient elder cultivator who is Sen's master and one of the trusted figures in his inner circle.
characters.name: Master Feng

characters.description: An elder close to Sen who shares in caring for Ai and Jur. She coaches Sen on how a leader should present himself, advising him to keep an aloof public bearing.
characters.name: Auntie Caihong

characters.description: The feared enforcer of Sen's sect, who removes nuisances and helps keep petitioners away from Sen. His strict discipline stops senior members from abusing juniors. Sen regards him as brutal but loyal and efficient, and means to reward him.
characters.name: Long Jia Wei

characters.description: An elder of Sen's sect whom he trusts with the logistics of settling the rescued villagers he has brought back to his town.
characters.name: The sect administrator

characters.description: A young foundation formation cultivator of Sen's sect, known to Ai and Jur as Big Sister Lei. She carries the message that the spirit beast war has begun. Wary and perceptive, she senses Sen's flash of rage and grasps that he would destroy anyone who harmed Ai. Sen tells her to stay close.
characters.name: Chen Lei

characters.description: Sen's niece, a small girl who spends a day out with Sen and Ai, including a visit to a bakery. Her mother is Li Hua.
characters.name: Jur

characters.description: Sen's grandmother and the head of the House of Lu in the capital. As the war breaks out she calls the family's members back to the capital manor and closes its gates, and Sen sends cultivators to strengthen her defenses.
characters.name: Grandmother Lu

characters.description: A nascent soul cultivator in the capital and Master Feng's brother. He bears a grudge against Sen, which Sen learned of from Lai Dongmei, and may be strong enough to hold off Master Feng or Uncle Kho for a time. Master Feng promises to deal with him personally.
characters.name: Master Feng's brother

characters.description: A person Sen knows who told him that Master Feng's brother holds a grudge against him.
characters.name: Lai Dongmei

characters.description: A seamstress about Sen's age and the mother of Jur, friendly with Sen and Ai. When Sen offers the town's mortals elixirs that ignite cultivation, he stops her before she drinks one and arranges for someone who endured the painful process to explain it to her first. Her choice is left open.
characters.name: Li Hua

characters.description: The king, ruling a capital overwhelmed by refugees and short of food. Exhausted and short-tempered, he approves cutting refugee rations for winter, rejects conscription as unaffordable, and drafts a functionary who proposed it callously. In private he gives way to despair.
characters.name: Jiang

characters.description: An awakened elder ghost panther of great power. Sen suspects intelligent beasts like him coordinate the spirit beast armies, but judges that he would lose to this one in single combat and cannot hope to capture him yet.
characters.name: Boulder Shadow

characters.description: The matriarch of the Golden Phoenix sect, a nascent soul cultivator, and Sen's lover and ally. In the capital she plays the planned voice of mercy at the public judgment of a defiant noble house, persuading Sen to spare the soldiers and children. She agrees to serve as the one person seen to temper his anger, and she helps him cow the war council by humiliating a challenger.
characters.name: Lai Dongmei

characters.description: A Ninetail fox spirit beast and an acquaintance of Sen who hides her nature among the humans of the capital. She came to help humanity survive and shelters other foxes in a house she bought, though food and supplies are running low. She is weighing whether to reveal herself to Sen so the foxes' illusions can aid the defense.
characters.name: Misty Peak

characters.description: A handsome cultivator representing the Calamitous Fist sect at the capital's war council. He questions Sen's report of the beast numbers, is cornered by Lai Dongmei into kneeling and apologizing, and is made to stand by the wall in disgrace.
characters.name: The Calamitous Fist representative

characters.description: A nascent soul elder of the Lunar Tiger Sect who scoffs at the value of mortals during the war council. Sen silences him with a growing sphere of black lightning and a warning not to harm mortals, after which he falls into line.
characters.name: The Lunar Tiger Sect elder

characters.description: A resident of Lu Manor who is close to Grandmother Lu and on easy, teasing terms with Sen. The manor's defensive formations never turn on her. She jokes with Sen about having become a dictator.
characters.name: Lo Meifeng

characters.description: A cultivator who once traveled with Sen and Lo Meifeng between the Clear Spring sect and the capital, back then plump and cowardly. An elixir from Sen lifted him to core formation, and he returns lean and assured. He admits he resents Sen but is grateful, and he comes to Lu Manor seeking orders for the battle as a wandering cultivator.
characters.name: Sen's old traveling companion

characters.description: A mortal general who won his rank in battle and admits twenty years of peace have softened him. He had thought little of Sen until the lightning strike, after which he sees him as an army in himself. He walks the wall to steady the troops and orders the alarm when the horde advances.
characters.name: The old general

characters.description: A nascent soul cultivator of the Lunar Tiger Sect with a moon-linked intuition; years earlier he had a vision of Sen as a god soaked in blood. During the siege he is turned away by Lu Manor's defenses, apologizes to Lai Dongmei for a jab, and flies out with her to face two powerful evolved spirit beasts, fighting with pale blades of moonlight.
characters.name: The Lunar Tiger nascent soul fighter

characters.description: A woman who uses a chi-formed false face to slip into Sen's sickroom at Lu Manor while Lo Meifeng is away. She blames Sen for ruining her family and expected a large payment for killing him. Sen, already awake, stops her and burns out her cultivation for good, keeping her for Lo Meifeng to question.
characters.name: The would-be assassin

recaps.ending: The spirit beast army that besieged the capital has been wiped out, first by Sen's lightning strike on its formation and then by the storm weapon he built after reaching nascent soul. The wilds around the city have been burned back for miles. Boulder Shadow, the one survivor Sen deliberately spared, has gone to carry Sen's declaration of total war to the Beast King. Sen now rules the capital kingdom in practice, with Jiang's consent. He keeps order through fear, executes anyone caught planning a killing, and has turned the Ninetail foxes into scouts and spies under Lo Meifeng, with an official bureau and laws to protect them. Disciples from his sect have arrived to grow food for the winter, and he has promised an army to hunt the spirit beasts. Jiang survives but lost an eye and needs proper healing beyond the elixir that stabilized him, and Sen considers himself in his debt. Lai Dongmei is recovering from her wounds and stays at Sen's side as his public conscience. Lo Meifeng is resting at Lu Manor, and the assassin is still waiting for her questioning. Misty Peak remains in Sen's service. Ai, Falling Leaf and Auntie Caihong are safe back at the home town, where the sect administrator runs things and Glimmer of Night still works on the unsolved communication network. Master Feng and Uncle Kho are away enforcing the new order. Open threads include Master Feng's missing brother, the Beast King's reply, the black lightning darkness that destroyed a wyvern, the change in Sen's skin, Long Jia Wei's hidden unit, winter attacks, private resentment among the sects and nobles, and what Sen means when he says he must burn the world to save it. Sen plans to leave the capital to secure the rest of the kingdom.
recaps.in_short: As the spirit beast war begins, Sen protects his growing town, rescues Falling Leaf from rogue beasts who meant to sell her to the Beast King, and destroys a beast host to give humanity hope. When human powers fragment instead of uniting, Master Feng and Uncle Kho set him up as a tyrant to force them together. Sen turns many of the town's mortals into cultivators, advances his sect, and risks an untested elixir that makes Falling Leaf stronger. Called to the besieged capital, he seizes authority from King Jiang, makes an example of a defiant noble house with Lai Dongmei as the voice of mercy, and enlists Misty Peak's hidden Ninetail foxes to shelter civilians. His plan to draw storm lightning wrecks the beasts' formation but cracks his core and leaves him in a coma, where he confronts three past versions of himself and breaks through to nascent soul. He wakes in time to stop an assassin, clears the walls, and turns the storm into a weapon that annihilates the beast army. He sends Boulder Shadow to the Beast King with a declaration of total war, stabilizes the dying Jiang, makes the foxes his spies, and rules the capital by fear while preparing to march out and secure the kingdom.

recaps.text:
So far this book: Sen brings a group of rescued villagers back to his town, where his daughter Ai arrives riding a young feng huang that Uncle Kho thought extinct. The bird hints that the spirit oxen sent it. The villagers resent being housed in a warehouse, and a cultivator who travels with them tells Sen they know only his strength and not his mercy. Sen grudgingly accepts that he is becoming a ruler as the town grows.

The sect administrator and Long Jia Wei keep petitioners away so Sen can have a rare quiet day with Ai and his niece Jur, while Master Feng, Auntie Caihong and Uncle Kho help mind the girls. The day ends when a young sect cultivator, Chen Lei, brings word that the spirit beast war has started in the south. Sen holds back his urge to fly there and instead takes charge of the town's defense. Master Feng looks after Ai while Sen goes to the leadership meeting, where the worn-out administrator gives him the chair and Glimmer of Night, a spider kin in human guise who studies crystal, is present. The report is grim: dozens of southern villages are gone, thousands are dead, and the capital is in turmoil. Grandmother Lu has sealed the family manor there, and Sen sends cultivators to help. The sects are not cooperating with mortal forces. Sen doubles the watch and assigns Chen Lei to assist the overworked sect administrator.

Sen senses Falling Leaf being hunted by spirit beasts and rescues her. A small group of beasts then begs him for sanctuary, but Falling Leaf reveals their faction ambushed her and planned to hand her to the Beast King. When two of them attack her, Sen kills both. Leaving the four survivors under guard, he tracks down the faction's main body of over a hundred beasts and annihilates it with a sphere of black lightning and a rain of elemental spears, sparing a single beast to spread the story.

So far this book: Sen restores the crater his attack left behind and explains that he wanted witnesses so the news would give people hope. He orders the exhausted sect administrator to rest. The story of the slaughter lifts human morale, but most sects still act only to defend their own compounds, and Master Feng has to physically stop Sen from attacking one that ignored a razed town nearby. The town is renamed in Sen's honor and its elders openly back his rule, leaving him effectively its king. He approves crop trials and mining to address food and metal shortages.

Two weeks later, humanity is splintering: local strongmen are carving out petty kingdoms and the cities are not working together. Master Feng, who is also Feng Ming, the cultivator called Fate's Razor, tells Sen he foresaw this. He argues that the capital and other cities will fall unless someone forces the sects and mortal powers into line, and that Sen should be that tyrant precisely because he values lives and would give up power afterward. The idea came from Uncle Kho, and the two elders will enforce it. Sen protests that he is too young and inexperienced, but Master Feng frames it as a choice between guarding one town and saving the world.

So far this book: Long Jia Wei, overwhelmed by the flood of refugee cultivators, quietly recruits three ruthless newcomers into a hidden unit that answers to him and, in principle, to Sen, without telling Sen. Sen explains honestly to Ai that he may have to leave to fight, and she tells him he should help the people who are being hurt. He agrees to hear out the plan. Master Feng and Uncle Kho will announce Sen's leadership to cities and sects, starting with persuasion and escalating to force. Sen warns that Master Feng's brother, a nascent soul cultivator in the capital, holds a grudge against him, and Master Feng says he will handle his brother himself. The two elders depart while Auntie Caihong stays to guard Ai.

Sen decides to strengthen his sect as quickly as possible. He and Auntie Caihong brew elixirs that can ignite cultivation in mortals close to the threshold, and Sen offers them to the townsfolk with a frank warning that taking one means fighting and possibly dying. Most accept. He holds back Li Hua, Jur's mother, until someone can tell her how painful the process is. In the capital, King Jiang cuts refugee rations for winter and sinks into private despair, while his core cultivator bodyguard considers leaving for Sen's stronghold. Sen's push advances much of the sect, though no one reaches nascent soul. He admits to Falling Leaf that he has delayed his own breakthrough out of fear of failure and of an ascension that would part him from Ai.

So far this book: Sen prepares a risky elixir from rare ingredients and shadow-affinity beast cores to advance Falling Leaf, whose body has a core but no dantian. She drinks it calmly and endures a long, agonizing ordeal before falling into a deep sleep, and Sen keeps vigil for days, fearing her mind has been damaged. Ai tells her stories while she sleeps. Long Jia Wei, now part of the leadership meetings, tells Sen he has recruited helpers as an experiment and will reveal them later. Falling Leaf finally wakes, hungry and unharmed, three days after the advancement, and Sen resolves never to put her through such uncertainty again.

A beast tide strikes the town and Sen defeats it, leaving burned forest and many carcasses to clear. While he fights, Falling Leaf realizes she loves Ai. The attack convinces Sen he must lead the war more actively, but Falling Leaf talks him out of forcing a nascent soul breakthrough, and he decides to wait until he is ready. The communication cores Glimmer of Night produces only link pairs and need constant upkeep, so the two begin trying to invent a web of relay nodes. Sen suspects intelligent beasts such as Boulder Shadow, an elder ghost panther too strong for him to face alone, coordinate the beast armies. Weeks of work on the nodes go nowhere. Sen teaches his disciples to focus killing intent, and Chen Lei arrives with a message from the king.

So far this book: The king's message reports that Master Feng announced the new order in the capital and crushed a sect whose leader resisted. Most noble houses are preparing to revolt, held back by Jiang with Grandmother Lu's support, and huge numbers of beasts are converging on the capital. Sen hands the town to the sect administrator, leaves Glimmer of Night working on the nodes, takes a ring of about two thousand cracked cores, says goodbye to Ai, and flies out. On the way he develops a far faster method of flight and decides body cultivators could form a rapid response force.

He finds the capital ringed by a vast beast army building an enormous formation to break the walls. Entering the city, he greets Jiang as a superior and kills a newly advanced nascent soul woman who challenges him. Misty Peak, a Ninetail fox hiding refugee foxes in the city, considers revealing herself to him. When a noble threatens to withhold his soldiers, Sen condemns his entire house. In private, Jiang admits he killed his father and brother for the throne but accepts Sen's takeover, and Sen explains that Grandmother Lu gave him his family name. At the public judgment, Lai Dongmei, Golden Phoenix matriarch and Sen's lover, pleads for the soldiers and children as planned. The noble is executed by a woman of his house, and the rest are stripped of rank and put to work. Lai Dongmei tells Sen that Master Feng nearly killed his own brother, who has since fled. Sen cows the war council, warns a Lunar Tiger elder not to harm mortals, and begins organizing roughly forty thousand defenders.

So far this book: With the beasts' formation a few days from completion, the outer districts are evacuated and the Lunar Tiger elder takes charge of extending and sealing the walls. When he reports a shortage of stone, Sen tears a large mass of it from the ground, draining much of his chi. Sen visits Lu Manor, where Grandmother Lu greets him with a sharp tongue and remarks that he looks larger, while Lo Meifeng teases him about being a dictator. They tell him that Misty Peak has approached the manor and argue that the foxes' illusions could hide civilians if the walls are breached.

At her crowded house, Misty Peak drops her playful manner and admits the foxes are starving and afraid. Sen agrees to accept their help without promising their safety, and lets the fox children shelter at Lu Manor. He presents her to the city's leaders under her human name, and when she is exposed as a fox he claims she serves him. She describes the Beast King's persecution of her kind, and Sen notes the ghost panthers suffered the same fate. Lai Dongmei is cool toward Misty Peak. Sen tells Lai Dongmei he intends to borrow lightning from the storm hanging over the city and channel it through the spikes on the palace walls, though he does not yet know how. An old traveling companion of Sen's, transformed by an elixir into a confident core cultivator, arrives at Lu Manor seeking a role in the fight.

So far this book: Sen works out how to pull lightning into the palace spikes through fine channels and small linked formations carved into the stone. Knowing the gathering power will provoke an immediate attack, the city readies its defenses, posting cultivators to empower arrows and bolts and giving Sen's cracked cores to the ballista crews, while non-fighters gather under the foxes' illusions. His old companion arrives, having nearly died in the tribulation that followed his breakthrough, and is sent to the base of the wall.

Hovering over the palace, Sen triggers the technique. An old ghost panther posted as an observer, who had argued against attacking so soon, watches the lightning turn into black orbs of annihilation that destroy the beasts' formation and kill tens of thousands. Sen falls from the sky and is caught by a woman in white robes. The next day, a veteran mortal general who once dismissed Sen now regards him as an army in himself, but the surviving horde surges out of the forest toward the walls, and the general orders the alarm raised.

So far this book: Sen lies in a coma at Lu Manor, watched over by Lai Dongmei, who cannot trust any healer in the city with him. His grandmother tends him and recounts his hard childhood: how he was bullied, stole food to share with her, and bargained for her care before leaving with Feng Ming. When fighting erupts at the wall, Lai Dongmei leaves to join it, telling Jiang that Sen is only recovering from chi exhaustion. Jiang doubts her. Feeling he is no longer truly king, he takes up a bow on the wall beside the general despite objections, and the prepared arrows and bolts tear through the attackers with fire, lightning, ice and stone. Sen's old companion fights flying beasts while the defenders save their strength for stronger foes. Inside his own mind, Sen wakes in a black void with no sense of chi and faces three younger versions of himself, who accuse him of becoming like a noble, of drowning in blood, and of lacking balance.

So far this book: Trapped in the void, Sen pieces together what happened: far more lightning came down than he planned, some laced with divine chi, and it struck him three times and cracked his core in what amounted to a nascent soul tribulation. He concludes the heavens are forcing him to gain the self-knowledge Fu Ru Lan said such a breakthrough requires.

Outside, three days pass without him. Lai Dongmei keeps his condition secret as morale falls and sects quarrel. The nascent soul cultivators engage only the strongest beasts, the foxes' illusions hide the wounded and civilians, and beasts tunneling under the walls are stopped. Lai Dongmei and a Lunar Tiger nascent soul fighter fly out to face a tiger beast and a lizard-woman beast. The fight goes badly, and the lizard woman reveals the beasts' aim is to hold the nascent soul cultivators outside while the city's interior lies open. At Lu Manor, Lo Meifeng, close to peak core formation, leaves her trainees to guard Sen's room and sets out with a young cultivator to check on the foxes, with Grandmother Lu urging her to come back alive.

So far this book: Misty Peak orders the foxes to strengthen their illusions as beasts erupt from the ground, and Lo Meifeng and her young companion arrive to save her. Lo Meifeng tells her Sen may be dying. In the void, Sen cuts away the youngest self, his blind hatred of nobles, adapts the second self's peaceful ideals to the real world, and sets the third self, balance, aside for later. The darkness splits open and power rushes into him as he begins to advance.

At Lu Manor, a woman wearing a false face made of chi tries to stab Sen in his sickbed, blaming him for her family's ruin. Sen, now awake, stops her and permanently destroys her cultivation, holding her for Lo Meifeng to question. Outside the walls, an immense technique kills countless beasts and leaves them impaled along the wall. Lai Dongmei uses the distraction to kill the lizard woman, and her ally beheads the tiger. Seeing a blue-robed figure overhead, she realizes Sen has reached nascent soul. Sen hunts down the beasts inside the city, gives his own elixirs to the two wounded fighters, and notices his once bone-pale skin now has color. Sensing enough power in the storm to finish the battle, he flies up into the clouds.

So far this book: Inside the storm, Sen finds divine chi woven through the clouds and concludes the heavens are using him as their weapon, which he accepts in order to save the capital. He destroys the flying beasts that rush him, while a living darkness of black lightning of unknown origin tears apart a huge wyvern. He shapes the storm into a vortex stretching dozens of miles, shielding one familiar presence so a witness will survive. From the wall, a one-eyed, exhausted Jiang watches the storm kill tens of thousands of beasts with lightning, black oblivion and fire, burning the wilds back for miles. Grandmother Lu fears the people will turn on Sen once the fighting stops.

The survivor is Boulder Shadow. Sen painfully crushes his soul and sends him to tell the Beast King that humanity will burn the wilds and wipe out the spirit beasts. Sen then turns the remaining clouds to rain and resolves to spare the spirit oxen and some forest for Falling Leaf's sake. He finds Jiang dying from exhaustion and organ damage that the sect healers missed because he is mortal, and brews a mortal-safe elixir to stabilize him. The old general warns he would resist any purge of the royal family, and Sen says he will not purge it and will rule as little as he can.

So far this book: Sen finds Lo Meifeng wounded but stable and does not blame her for joining the fight. He sends her to rest at Lu Manor under escort and expects old scores to be settled violently soon. He thanks Misty Peak for keeping her word, feeds the exhausted fox leader, and warns her that if the foxes stay he will put them to use. She accepts. He makes them scouts and spies under Lo Meifeng, planning an innocuously named bureau and laws to protect them, with Jiang's agreement.

Two weeks after the battle, Sen is busy stopping assassinations across the capital, with masked fox agents taking the culprits into custody. Disciples from his sect arrive with a storage ring of food from the town, and Sen announces that the city will not starve and that he will raise an army to hunt the spirit beasts. The disciples begin building walled farmland, warming formations and glass growing houses. Sen publicly executes would-be murderers, mortal and cultivator alike, and makes even planning a killing a capital crime, allowing only duels between cultivators of equal level. The sects grumble privately. Sen now understands why Master Feng and Uncle Kho made him a tyrant, but is troubled by how easily he can order deaths. He fears winter attacks and treachery if he leaves the capital. Lai Dongmei tells him every ruler governs through fear, and Sen concludes that humanity is too divided and that he will have to burn the world to save it.

characters.description: The narrator, a former college dropout who became Earth's forerunner when the planet was pulled into a contest between five worlds. His travels have taken him through the evacuation of Galen, the fey realms and the Divided Realms, and he has helped bring down the god Primus. He is engaged to Selena of House Turga, is the blood brother of Ryan. He is quietly an architect-type figure with unusual access to the system.
characters.name: Silas

characters.description: Silas's blood brother. He lands the final blow on Primus, god of the Divided Realms, and rises to divine tier, which grants Silas a flat stat bonus through their bond. He has several wives. Before the party leaves, he urges Silas to get home soon because he senses danger tied to time, and he warns that other powerful figures may rebel.
characters.name: Ryan

characters.description: An immensely powerful woman, ranked above anything primordial, who freezes time while Silas crosses the void and is found calmly reading at a table. She tells him his primordial aspect is locked, that he is going to be tested, and that collecting favors would be wise. She offers no direct help and forbids him to tell his companions about the meeting.
characters.name: Ea

characters.description: Silas's fiancee, a member of House Turga, one of the peak families. Their engagement tied Silas into the web of great houses. She travels back toward Earth with him after the fall of Primus.
characters.name: Selena

characters.description: One of Silas's closest companions and his mentor through earlier adventures. His bonded dragon carries the party through the void on the trip back to Earth after the fight with Primus.
characters.name: Samvek

characters.description: A longtime companion of Silas who travels home with him from the Divided Realms. She points out that he is both valuable and a target, and that most of those hunting for power do not yet know he is an architect.
characters.name: Lana

characters.description: Samvek's companion and a healer. She is part of the group that returns from the Divided Realms with Silas.
characters.name: Talia

characters.description: Silas's chief of staff on Earth, who is plugged into the planet's satellite network and keeps track of his affairs while he is away.
characters.name: Simone

characters.description: Silas's adoptive father in House Kalestian. Because of the adoption, Kalestian ships orbiting Earth address Silas as Lord Kalestian and treat him as fifth in line in the family. Abel himself is absent.
characters.name: Abel

characters.description: Silas's mother, who lives in a community of more than 100,000 people inside the safe zone around Champaign, Illinois. She has reached rare tier and helps organize the settlement's many crafters. She had been anxious about her son until Lana's divination confirmed he was alive.
characters.name: Silas's mother

characters.description: The gruff caretaker and organizer of the large community where Silas's mother lives, and her partner. He greets Silas when he lands at his mother's home.
characters.name: Wilmarth

characters.description: A senior Alliance military officer and one of Silas's main contacts on Earth. Silas puts a meeting with him near the top of his schedule after returning home.
characters.name: General Krulak

characters.description: One of Earth's forerunners and a past ally of Silas. She is conducting genetic research on the moon, where dungeons have been spreading. Silas trusts her, but with some caution.
characters.name: Asta

characters.description: A forerunner who held temporary authority over Earth until a system notice stripped it away. He commands the Vanguard, a force of nearly 2,000 that has cut casualties sharply, and he has shed his earlier arrogance. He admits to a romance with Ada despite pressure from Chinese officials. Silas equips him with more than 400 golems and four control gauntlets.
characters.name: Jiang

characters.description: An African forerunner who holds a large Ethiopian city against the monster waves. She is in a relationship with Jiang.
characters.name: Ada

characters.description: Silas's younger sister, a forerunner at level 250 who is waiting for permission to advance further. She arrives at their mother's house with her boyfriend Chad, a healer and former medic. She shares the distinctive forerunner trait and is visibly uneasy around Asta.
characters.name: Silas's sister

characters.description: The boyfriend of Silas's younger sister. He is a healer who once worked as a medic, and he comes with her when she visits their mother's home.
characters.name: Chad

characters.description: A legendary-tier Duelist Mage of House Kalestian whose post as Envoy Monitor has been dissolved. He appears in the backyard of Silas's mother's house and offers to serve as Silas's advisor and liaison to the house, reporting only to Abel unless Silas allows otherwise. He tells Silas that 30,000 legendary troops and five generals now answer to Silas. Silas accepts on condition that Darius keeps other houses from planting advisors. His gauntlet cannot be read by Identify.
characters.name: Darius

characters.description: Silas's Eidolon, a four-armed fighter with black skin and white wings who can unleash a sonic taunt. When six portals open across Earth, Silas summons him to help defend Beijing.
characters.name: Erg

characters.description: A lepon necromancer who, in an earlier adventure, died and was absorbed into Sanctuary's protective tree. She returns as Earth's planetary guardian, three stories tall and at Ascendant tier, marked by roots and silver veins in her fur, with amethyst eyes and crystal ears. Her arrival gives Silas a 10 percent boost, and she throws herself at the kaiju ravaging Tokyo.
characters.name: Vex

characters.description: A German member of the Terran Council who pushed a vote of no confidence in Silas, which the system rendered void. He remains popular in Berlin, where banners bearing his first name are on display.
characters.name: The German council representative

characters.description: Lord of Clan Raiden and Samvek's father. After weeks of seclusion he ascends, and the system binds him to 1,000 years of service. The service will be waived if he trains Silas, whom the system calls a new architect, and secures his loyalty to the heavens. Golden lightning plays over him. After hearing secrets from his friend Baran, he pledges loyalty to Silas as a clansman, provided Silas does not prove unworthy.
characters.name: Samuel Rayden

characters.description: A priest of the Sect of the Veiled Infinity, an old friend of Samuel Rayden, and someone Samvek regards as an uncle. He ascends alongside Samuel. Behind wards that block all listening, he shares secrets about Silas involving prophecies and bloodlines, and reports that seers have seen Silas rise in many futures, most ending in destruction and only a few in salvation.
characters.name: Baran

characters.description: A goddess who bears a grudge against Silas. When Samuel Rayden ascends, the system warns that she resents Silas. She is forbidden to move against a fellow architect directly, but she is able to bend the rules of the heavens.
characters.name: The hostile goddess

characters.description: Selena's father, of House Turga. Together with Selena's uncle he places a long-range call to her at a Turga station and urges her to marry Silas within the month, pointing to rival families and the purity of Silas's bloodline. He refers to Silas as the Forerunner and hopes the match will produce children. Selena declines to name a date and leaves the timing to Silas.
characters.name: Selena's father

characters.description: Selena's uncle, of House Turga. He joins her father on a long-range call to Selena, and the two press her to wed Silas within the month for the sake of the family's standing against rivals. Selena refuses to commit to a date.
characters.name: Selena's uncle

characters.description: A brother and sister of legendary tier, with bronze skin, amber eyes, claws and burnt-orange hair, children of the head of a clan founded by a god. They call theirs the first clan and want to open a chapter house on Earth. The brother loses a duel to Silas fought without abilities, and the sister flirts until Silas says he is engaged, then turns the talk to a contract.
characters.name: The first-clan siblings

characters.description: A dead woman whose soul is bound to a choker that Abel made, which Silas carries. She appears to him as herself, with black hair and pale skin, in a timeless gray space. She identifies the Sicarius from an earlier vision of his, tells him some people may want him captured, and approves of his choice of Selena.
characters.name: Lily

characters.description: An order of the most lethal assassins in the multiverse, hired to kill targets at peak legendary or ascendant strength. Lily warns Silas that one of them matches a figure from his earlier vision and that hits may be placed on him.
characters.name: The Sicarius

characters.description: An earlier candidate for the tests that Ea is running. According to Ea, he was turned down because he had nothing primordial in him. He is also the original source of the Psy power that Silas uses.
characters.name: Jay

characters.description: The chief shareholder of RA Corporation, a figure who operates in the multiverse's underside. Silas owes him a blind favor. He meets Abel in the corona of a dying star, refuses Abel's offer to buy out the favor, and reveals he knows Silas is an architect. He claims he funded the portals into Earth to help Silas, and he knows Abel is looking for a way past the barriers to divine tier.
characters.name: RA Corporation's chief shareholder

characters.description: A manager at the Trancheck corporation and Silas's contact there. When the board discusses how to handle Silas, he argues for giving him resources and administrative help without demanding anything back, pointing out that pressure on earlier rivals backfired. He intends to deliver the company's invitation to Silas.
characters.name: Rain

characters.description: An ascendant of House Kalestian who left his birth world ten thousand years ago and calls Silas his younger brother. Wealthy and calculating, he prepays a Trancheck director five trillion credits for supplies Silas will need. In exchange for a personal cut, she must write the contract so Silas has to appear in person at the ring-world Kashar Station, where Tiberian intends to meet him away from Earth.
characters.name: Tiberian Kalestian

characters.description: Lana's older sister, proud, close to ascension, and a rival to Lana. When Silas and Lana arrive at the Kalestian palace world of Ondurin, she receives them with thinly veiled condescension, says she expects to follow their mother as head of the empire's daily rule, and leads them to the Empress.
characters.name: Chloe

characters.description: Lana's mother, a level-500 ruler who has run the Kalestian empire day to day for a few hundred years, while Abel remains its true head. She bows to Silas as a son of the founder and asks him to call her sister. She pledges 300,000 administrators and as many trainers for Earth's safe zones. When she and her daughter Chloe suggest Silas should have chosen Lana, he defends his friendship with Lana, and she approves.
characters.name: The Empress

characters.description: A far older and more powerful version of Silas, whose face Silas sees after being pulled to the edge of the astral plane. He is engaged in a vast shaping against unraveling timelines, has lost many people, and does not remember ever meeting his younger self. He pulls the younger Silas out at the moment of a past mistake.
characters.name: Future Silas

characters.description: A duchess of hell, recently captured and humiliated, who is one of Silas's vassals in the hell system. The hell king sends her back to Earth to encourage Silas to take more risks. She has sworn an oath to Silas not to spy on him.
characters.name: The devil duchess

characters.description: A 400-foot blue-and-platinum dragon emperor who once killed the Mother of Dragons. When he senses echoes of her in Silas's surge of power, he moves angrily toward Earth until the god of magic who serves him says the matter is being handled. He is bonded to a divine woman in crimson armor, who offers to go to Earth as an observer.
characters.name: The dragon emperor

characters.description: One of Ryan's wives, now a demigoddess with a cultivator core. When Ryan feels his blood bond with Silas burn and then go silent, he sends her to Earth to find out what happened.
characters.name: Kumo

characters.description: A dark god who acts as patron to the Sicarius assassins. After Silas kills one of the three assassins attacking his family, the other two flee through a portal, and Silas senses this god's presence behind it.
characters.name: The death god

characters.description: A kind demigoddess healer who comes from the dragons' side and works with souls. She takes custody of the assassin's soul that Silas captured and brings him back to Earth. Silas trusts her, and her call carries the dragon emperor's authority, which brings dragons in to help with disaster relief.
characters.name: The soul healer

characters.description: A fragment of Silas that spread into one of the fleeing assassins through his self-propagation ability and was carried into a death god's realm. It takes over the assassin's body, suppresses the original mind, and calls itself Silas B. It keeps Silas's memories and loyalty and quietly gathers intelligence from inside the death god's domain.
characters.name: Silas B

characters.description: The god of gambling and the original god of the heavens. He shows up unannounced at Silas and Selena's wedding, appearing just as Silas steps onto the platform. His reasons for coming are unknown.
characters.name: Lucky

characters.description: A blonde woman who appears to Silas at his wedding and says she is Jay's wife. Identify shows him nothing about her and she gives off no aura, though she holds a vast reserve of Psy. She touches his temple, and he gains Psy germination, the power to awaken Psy in humans who carry the right bloodline. Selena afterward says no one was there.
characters.name: Amelia

recaps.ending: Silas closes the book married to Selena, now Selena Renner. He is level 418 and must reach level 501 to ascend. His soul has evolved toward a demigod-like state while his body remains mortal. His Draconic Dust is frozen at 99 percent, and he now has Psy germination, a gift that came through Jay. The system has warned him that the heavens' protection will not last. Earth is stable: about 99 percent of survivors live in six safe zones, civilian monster deaths are near zero, the Terran Council is suspended, and appointed leaders govern the zones, with Selena acting for Europe. Jiang, Ada, Asta, Lana, Kumo and Silas's sister, who is now legendary and his third horseman, remain on Earth. Samuel and Baran, his frontier mentors, attended the wedding, where Baran officiated, and they and Samvek remain with Clan Raiden. The asteroid with Silas's world-tree node now sits in Earth orbit as a possible gateway for chimeras. Open threads: the death god and the escaped Sicarius still hunt him, while Silas B secretly controls one assassin's body in that god's realm; a hostile goddess wants him gone, and RA Corporation's chief shareholder still holds his blind favor. Tiberian warns that the other Kalestian brothers will test Silas, and Abel remains blocked from divine tier. The titans are moving. Ea's candidacy and its purpose are unexplained, and a parchment from Future Silas waits unread in his storage. Erg's recovery, Lucky's dice, the question of children, the hell-prince challenge, the infinity key, and about eight years of Earth's probation remain ahead, starting with a honeymoon in a legendary-tier dungeon.
recaps.in_short: Silas, Earth's forerunner, comes home after the fall of Primus to find himself declared Earth's undisputed ruler. A mysterious being named Ea tells him he will be tested. When a level-500 kaiju devastates Tokyo, Vex returns as planetary guardian to kill it, and Silas strains his architect powers to save twenty million people, which gets him locked out of the system. He builds housing for millions and sentences Asta to a symbolic death for her experiments. He then spends a system boon creating six safe zones and rewrites the system so future worlds receive them too. Earth's politicians plot against him, and a German council member hires Sicarius assassins who kill his mother's partner and his sister. Silas saves his mother and sister in storage, where they are reborn stronger. He kills one assassin, forges its soul into a weapon, then exposes and executes the conspirator and disbands the council. Along the way he takes on dragon power, meets his own future self, and is introduced to his adoptive brother Tiberian. He trains on the frontier under Samuel Rayden and Baran, then returns to a stable Earth and marries Selena before gods and clans, receiving a Psy gift from Jay through Jay's wife Amelia.

recaps.text:
Silas watches his blood brother Ryan finish off Primus, god of the Divided Realms. Ryan rises to divine tier, and the bond between them gives Silas a stat bonus. Having also killed five enemy ascendants and shared in the god's death, Silas climbs to level 353. Ryan warns him to hurry home. While Samvek's dragon carries the party through the void, time stops and a woman calling herself Ea tells Silas that his primordial aspect is locked, that he will be tested, and that he should gather favors. He is not allowed to tell anyone.

Only months have passed on Earth. Kalestian ships hail him as Abel's adopted son, and the party splits: Lana goes to her house, Selena to House Turga, and Samvek and Talia to Clan Raiden. Silas flies to his mother's home in the safe zone around Champaign, Illinois. She lives in a thriving crafting community run by her partner Wilmarth, and she has become a rare-tier tamer of giant war dogs. A beast breeder linked to House Turga offers to supply more creatures, and Silas gives provisional approval. A system notice then names Silas Earth's undisputed ruler, strips Jiang of his temporary authority, voids a council vote against Silas, and warns of 180 days of harsher monster spawns.

Simone, his chief of staff, fills his schedule. Jiang reports that his Vanguard has cut casualties and admits to a relationship with Ada, and Silas hands him more than 400 golems along with four control gauntlets. His younger sister arrives at level 250 with her boyfriend Chad. As they talk, a powerful stranger teleports in behind the house.

The stranger is Darius, a Kalestian Duelist Mage whose old post has ended. He offers to be Silas's advisor and link to the house, and he reveals that 30,000 legendary troops are available to Silas. They sign a contract, and Silas approves of Chad.

Six huge portals then open at Washington, Beijing, Berlin, Tokyo, Buenos Aires and Addis Ababa. Allies divide the response: Clan Raiden, Jiang, Ada with Silas's sister, Lana and Selena each take a city, and Erg is sent to Beijing. Silas defends Tokyo, killing a wave of giant beasts before a 300-foot kaiju emerges. It is a level-500 creature tied to a group called the eternal auditors. Time freezes and the system offers to remove it with his unused Galen boon, rating his solo odds at under one in four. Silas refuses. Delayed experience lifts him to level 363, but the kaiju's breath kills more than a million people.

Vex arrives as Earth's new planetary guardian, a giant Ascendant necromancer, and holds the kaiju back with raised corpses and a scythe. With some twenty million survivors trapped at the bay, Silas burns his mana, life force and system power he seizes as an architect to teleport all of them to the Shawnee Forest in Illinois. The heavens punish him with a 24-hour ban on his system abilities. Vex beheads the kaiju, and Ea's voice remarks that he has learned something. Silas stores the corpse and drains its energy, and a red-text voice congratulates the candidate on passing his first test and grants him powerful lightning upgrades.

The souls of Tokyo's dead were destroyed by the auditors, so they cannot be restored. Silas offers the refugees a return home or a place in the safe zone, and Simone's staff grows into the thousands. She warns him that a German council representative pushed a no-confidence vote, that the great houses will eventually expect repayment, and that a hostile house is offering a suspiciously cheap contract.

In an interlude, Clan Raiden closes the Buenos Aires portal without losses. Samvek's father, Samuel Rayden, and the priest Baran both ascend. The system binds Samuel to train Silas and secure his loyalty to the heavens, and warns that a goddess resents Silas. Baran tells Samuel secrets about Silas, including that most foreseen futures end in destruction. Samuel pledges loyalty to Silas, provided Silas does not prove unworthy. Selena refuses her father's and uncle's demand that she marry within the month.

Two legendary siblings from a clan that calls itself the first ask to open a chapter house on Earth. Silas beats the brother in a duel without abilities and agrees to terms. Simone reports a badly overcrowded safe zone and credible claims that Asta has experimented on people. Silas caps the zone at one billion and blends power from several systems into one unified force. With the Tokyo kaiju's head as a battery, he builds 10,000 furnished towers across Iowa. As the bonds on his primordial aspect nearly fail, red text offers him immortality if he abandons humanity. He refuses, and Ea announces the second test.

In a timeless gray space, Silas sees a possible future in which he is an Ascendant leading modified warriors against an elven world, trying to tear down every system after his allies have died or turned on him. He glimpses other paths too. Lily appears from the choker that holds her soul. She identifies an assassin from an earlier vision as one of the Sicarius, elite killers hired against the most powerful targets. Ea then tells him an earlier candidate named Jay was rejected for lacking anything primordial, refuses to explain the candidacy, and declares the test passed.

Back in reality, Selena tells him about her family's pressure, and he says he would marry her at once. He sets priorities for housing. He also learns that captive thieves held in his storage are being forcibly evolved, which troubles him deeply. Selena argues that intent matters, and Simone urges him to negotiate with corporations to run the new cities.

Silas consults the alien scientist forerunner. He learns that Asta altered a cat-like species that now worships her, is building a dragon-blood serum for humans, and ran her early trials without consent. Silas declares the aliens Terrans as well. His sister and Jiang join him, and they go to Addis Ababa, which is under attack by two monster waves. Fighting without his system abilities, Silas and Erg break the ogre army while Jiang and his sister destroy the elemental hounds. The forerunners agree that confronting Asta comes next.

The forerunners travel to the moon, now a domed city of half a million people. A childlike dungeon core beneath it greets Silas as its manager. Asta, visibly changed by draconic self-experimentation, receives them. She explains that her father's experiments left her without ethical grounding, that she now uses only informed volunteers, and that no one has died since she changed her methods. Silas sees the system's hand behind her research and suspects the earlier notice about his captives was meant to sway him.

He finds her guilty of crimes against humanity. Jiang and Ada vote for death, and his sister abstains. Silas carries out a symbolic execution, driving Asta into the lunar rock and pulling her out again. Her conditions are to work under alien scientists while wearing a monitor, to halt experiments on people pending review, and to fight for Earth. Silas proposes an African safe zone overseen by Ada and warns that about nine years of Earth's probation remain.

Using his architect access, he forces the system to release his boon. One quarter of its energy creates a safe zone of 1,200-mile radius centered on the northern Congo, with a hunting preserve for leveling. Further zones follow in China, Australia, Europe and South America, making six in total. Silas takes the last energy into himself and writes a permanent rule that every newly inducted world gets a safe zone for each two billion people. He collapses. A system voice gives him thirty days to prepare before meeting new mentors and tells him to beware the titans.

In an interlude, the Trancheck corporation's board learns that Silas is an architect and opts to court him with generous terms. Abel offers to buy out a blind favor Silas owes RA Corporation's chief shareholder, who refuses, claims he funded Earth's portals to help Silas, and parts without a deal. On the frontier, a goddess loses ground to a chimeric horde led by two primordials and senses an unseen watcher.

Silas assigns rulers: Jiang takes China, Ada Africa and his sister South America, while Asta takes her forces to help Europe. The new zones have pushed portals and monsters into the borderlands. In Sydney he makes the police chief ruler of the Australian zone and builds evacuation portals. The first-clan siblings arrive with a hundred fighters, and together they destroy a spider swarm after the brother defeats its level-450 queen alone.

At the Raiden compound his system access returns. Asked where his loyalty lies, Silas answers that he will defend reality and its people. The system explains that architects stay individuals, that the first architect blocks change, and that titans are coming. In Berlin, angry council members demand limits on his power. Silas imposes martial law, orders members to reach epic tier within a year or lose their seats, removes the French delegate by force, and reorganizes the council by safe zone.

Selena takes him to a Turga station to meet her brother and uncle. The uncle presses for a fast wedding, which they decline, and reveals that ascendants rarely have children. House Turga pledges administrators and trainers for three zones, and Silas learns that Selena's father is fighting a chimeric horde.

In an interlude, Silas's adoptive older brother Tiberian Kalestian pays a Trancheck director to require Silas to come in person to Kashar Station. In Berlin, a Terran Council representative who resents Silas's rule hires a Sicarius to deliver a message by striking at someone close to Silas. Chimeras devastate a Turga core world, killing 243 million, and Selena's father suspects the titans.

Silas names Selena interim leader of the European zone. Samvek steps down as his mentor on his father's orders, and Silas suspects Samuel and Baran are the promised mentors. He sends the Kalestian legion to Earth in a support role, with guards for his mother and sister. With Lana he visits the Kalestian Empress, who treats him as her superior and pledges 300,000 administrators and as many trainers. When she and her daughter Chloe suggest he should have chosen Lana, he defends their friendship.

General Krulak warns that nearly a third of the council is plotting against him. Silas power-levels Simone, and Trancheck then insists he negotiate at Kashar Station. Erg warns of a coming loss and stays behind to guard his family. A courier carries Silas across space, and watching her gives him new insight into how the dimensions unify. Rain, a manager he knew from Galen, offers a sponsorship worth 22.5 trillion credits during probation plus later funds, and Silas plans to plant the Galen dungeon in South America. Sensing a hidden observer, he calls him out. It is Tiberian, a level-920 ascendant and third in line, who explains that all of Abel's sons are adopted human forerunners, warns that the other brothers will test him, and advises taking the deal.

Silas closes a trade deal at Kashar, and Erg summons him back to Earth. Together they kill a legendary Hivemaster. Bathing in its blood, Silas is offered a choice of system to strengthen and picks the dragon system. Draconic Dust floods him, the system warns he is dangerously unbalanced, and he flies away from Earth to keep from destroying it. At the edge of the astral plane he meets a far older version of himself.

In an interlude, the dragon emperor senses an echo of the Mother of Dragons he once killed, and his divine partner sets out to observe. Ryan sends his wife Kumo to Earth, and the hell king sends the devil duchess. Selena admits to herself that she loves Silas.

Future Silas beats his younger self for his recklessness, halts the dust at 99 percent, hides a parchment in Save for Winter, says everyone in his own timeline died, and erases the meeting from Silas's memory. Silas wakes with no memory of it. During a meditation he gains major upgrades, learns he must reach level 501 to ascend, and is warned the titans are moving.

Returning to his mother's home with three Galenian friends, he finds the guards and dogs dead. Three ascendant Sicarius hold his family behind a dimensional barrier. They stab his sister, and his mother's partner dies with his soul destroyed. Erg fuses with Silas, who breaks the barrier, stores his mother and sister in Save for Winter, and fights the assassins across a city and into space. He kills one and captures its soul. The other two escape through a portal toward a dark god, and a woman in crimson dragon-scale armor pulls Silas back.

Erg's bond is strained, and he withdraws to the astral plane to heal. A demigoddess healer takes custody of the captured soul and returns Silas to Earth, where he and Selena agree to marry soon. Over two days he rebuilds and helps with resurrections, but more than 10,000 people are lost for good. Freed from storage, his mother has evolved and grieves her partner, and his sister has been reborn as a phoenix. In a global broadcast, Silas reveals the assassins were hired from Earth and halts all travel to and from the planet.

Kumo and the devil duchess arrive, and the healer repairs Silas's torn soul, which evolves toward a demigod-like state. Absorbing the dead assassin's death gives him a soul-destroying dagger. The devil makes the captured soul relive its death, and it names the German council representative, adding that payment came from someone able to deal with a death god. Jiang goes to arrest him and Krulak detains the council. Silas and the healer forge the soul into a blood-fed artifact, Spikes of Blood's Vengeance.

In an interlude, a fragment of Silas that spread into a fleeing assassin takes over its body in the death god's realm and becomes Silas B. RA Corporation's chief shareholder breaks with a goddess who admits the titans cannot be beaten. Silas's sister forms a legendary core. The council member, abandoned by RA Corporation, flees into a dungeon. Silas sets the wedding for July 4 on Earth. He then pulls the councilman out on live broadcast, forces a confession, and beheads him. His aura draws admissions from about a third of the council and two generals, and he disbands the council pending elections by zone.

Within a month, most of Earth's survivors are living in safe zones, Silas has built housing for nearly all of them, and the Vanguard has grown past 17,000. He makes his sister his third horseman, leaves his mother on a Kalestian station, and settles wedding plans with Selena. Then the system teleports him away.

He lands on a hostile frontier where the system is weak and fights adaptive chimeras alone until he reaches Samuel Rayden, who becomes his mentor. Baran joins as a second mentor. Samuel admits the heavens told him to win Silas's loyalty, but says his own loyalty lies with the clan. Baran fears Silas could become a destroyer if pushed through enough suffering, and he is badly frightened when Silas speaks the name Ea. Baran also explains that Silas's self-propagation came from exposure to a collective-will contagion.

The assessment covers combat, leadership, negotiation, teaching and crafting, and Silas builds a golem by hand. He and Samuel fuse abilities into a strike that destroys an asteroid. Silas plants a seed of the Ways, which grows into a silver-white tree linked to Yggdrasil, a future dungeon entrance that draws chimera swarms. He then fights using only hell-class Vitae and only draconic power, learning several breath attacks while struggling with growing cravings. Finally he shows his primordial aspect, briefly makes chimeras kneel, and together with both mentors brings down an enormous chimera. He reveals that he can share Psy with them. Refusing further training, he invites both mentors to his wedding and flies the asteroid and its tree toward Earth at level 418.

After three weeks of travel, Silas brings the asteroid into Earth orbit, and Vex greets him. Civilian monster deaths are close to zero. He builds his mother a new home and finds her dogs resurrected and evolved. He reunites with his sister and Chad, and with Selena, who is hurt that he visited his mother first before they make up. Jiang reports a Vanguard capped at 20,000. Silas invites his Galenian friends to the wedding as family, requires every ascendant guest, including Abel's 300, to swear a binding oath of no harm, and finds Asta's lab compliant. He spends seven months building until more than 99 percent of people live in the zones.

The wedding is held in a restored Rome coliseum. The Kalestian brothers send gifts but do not attend. Peak houses, clans led by Samuel, the fey, the dragon emperor, Ryan with his wives, and the devil duchess all come, and Lucky, the original god of the heavens, arrives unannounced. Selena walks in alone, following Turga custom, and Baran officiates. They exchange rings that boost each other's stats, and Selena becomes Selena Renner. The system warns that the heavens' shield over Silas will not last. Lucky gives Selena one roll of his dice. A woman calling herself Amelia, Jay's wife, touches Silas's temple, unseen by anyone else, and grants him Psy germination, the power to awaken Psy in people with the right bloodline. The couple leaves for a honeymoon in a private legendary dungeon.

In the epilogue, an aged man who says Jay will teach him in the future asks Jay to send that gift, and a watching woman bides her time, convinced Silas will be the one to tip the balance.

characters.description: The fourth of the nine and the last narrator of the series. He is grieving Sarah, commanding an alliance he never asked to lead, and out of patience with anything that is not the end of the war. His Legacies are the broadest of any Garde and still growing. What he will not discuss is what he intends to spend to finish this, or that he has stopped assuming he will be alive when it is over.
characters.name: John Smith

characters.description: The sixth of the nine, invisible when she chooses and able to call down weather, and the most capable soldier the Loric have. With human forces and newly powered human teenagers joining the war, she becomes one of the people responsible for turning them into something that can fight rather than simply die bravely.
characters.name: Number Six

characters.description: The seventh of the nine, healer and one of the group's deadliest fighters, carrying a Legacy of lethal cold that came out of grief. She has been hardened by every book since Spain, and the war's last phase asks her to keep people alive faster than the Mogadorians can kill them.
characters.name: Marina

characters.description: The ninth of the nine, strong, fast, and able to move along any surface. He has spent the series wanting a straight fight against the Mogadorians and now has one, and he turns out to be better with the new human Garde than anyone expected him to be.
characters.name: Number Nine

characters.description: The youngest Garde, whose Legacies work on minds and dreams. Setrakus Ra's claim on her as his granddaughter and heir has left a connection between them that she cannot simply refuse, and it makes her both the Garde's best source on him and their most dangerous vulnerability.
characters.name: Ella

characters.description: The Mogadorian who broke with his own people, carrying the memories of Number One and an earth-shaking Legacy. He fights alongside the Garde against the species he was born into, and the intelligence he brings about Mogadorian command, ships, and doctrine is what makes an offensive possible at all.
characters.name: Adam

characters.description: John's human friend since Paradise, now with a Legacy of his own for reaching machines. He has been in this war longer than anyone except John and is no longer the person who has to be protected during it.
characters.name: Sam Goode

characters.description: Sam's father, whose memories of the Loric arrival on Earth have shaped every advantage the Garde have found. He works the research and liaison side of an alliance that now includes human governments and militaries.
characters.name: Malcolm Goode

characters.description: The fifth of the nine, who killed Number Eight, fought for the Mogadorians, and is held responsible by John for Sarah Hart's death. He can fly and take on the properties of anything he touches, and he knows both sides of this war from the inside, which is the only reason anyone considers what he has to say.
characters.name: Number Five

characters.description: The Mogadorian leader, who destroyed Lorien, hunted the nine across Earth, and now occupies its cities openly. He is not killable by any means the Garde have tried, and the claim he made on Ella has tied the two of them together in a way that makes striking at him dangerous to her.
characters.name: Setrakus Ra

characters.description: The Chimaera who has guarded John since Lorien, taking whatever animal shape a fight requires. He has been with John longer than any other survivor of their world.
characters.name: Bernie Kosar

recaps.ending: The war ends with Setrakus Ra dead and John Smith dead with him. Ordinary force could not kill the Mogadorian leader, and the link he forged with Ella meant that any attempt risked killing her too. John, whose Legacies had grown to include taking on the powers he sees others use, is the one who finds a way through and spends his own life doing it. The Mogadorian occupation collapses without him. Ella survives, freed from the claim he made on her. Six, Marina, Nine, Sam, Adam, and Malcolm survive, along with the human Garde whose Legacies the sanctuary released. A year later the surviving Loric have turned the aftermath into an institution: an academy where human teenagers with Legacies are gathered, taught, and kept from being used as weapons by their own governments, run by the Garde who fought the war. The Loric survivors are no longer the last of anything, because the Legacies they carried have passed into humanity, and Earth ends the series with a generation of people who can do what the nine could and a peace that has to be managed rather than won.
recaps.in_short: The final book turns the Garde's survival into an offensive. Working with human militaries and with the newly powered human Garde created when the sanctuary released Legacies into humanity, the surviving Loric go after the Mogadorian occupation city by city. Number Five surrenders and is imprisoned, offering intelligence on Setrakus Ra that the Garde need and John cannot forgive him enough to want. The obstacle is Setrakus Ra himself: nothing they have kills him, and the claim he made on Ella as his granddaughter has bound her life to his, so striking at him endangers her. John's Legacies expand until he can take on powers he watches other people use, and in the final assault he uses everything he has to destroy Setrakus Ra, dying in the act. The occupation collapses. Ella is freed, Six, Marina, Nine, Sam, Adam, and Malcolm survive, and a year later the survivors open an academy for the human teenagers whose Legacies the war produced.

recaps.text: Nine Loric children were sent to Earth with guardians called Cepans when the Mogadorians destroyed Lorien. Numbers One, Two, and Three were killed before the survivors ever met; every Cepan is dead, including Henri, who raised Number Four, John Smith. The survivors found each other one by one: Six, Seven (Marina), Eight, Nine, and Ten (Ella, from a second Loric ship), with John's human friend Sam Goode, Sam's father Malcolm, Sarah Hart, and the Chimaera Bernie Kosar. Number Five was found last and had already gone over to the Mogadorians; he killed Number Eight, and Marina took one of his eyes with a Legacy of lethal cold. Setrakus Ra captured Ella and told her she is his granddaughter and intended heir. Adam, a Mogadorian carrying the memories of Number One, defected and helped expose the enemy's plan to approach humanity openly. Setrakus Ra did so, then his fleet decloaked and the invasion began. In Mexico a surviving Loric presence released Legacies into ordinary humans worldwide; in New York Sarah Hart was killed, and John blames Five. Four of the nine are alive and free, one fights for the enemy, and Earth is occupied.

The Garde stop operating as fugitives and start operating as part of an alliance. Human governments and militaries, having watched their own forces fail against Mogadorian ships, accept Loric help, and the newly powered human teenagers appearing all over the world are being gathered rather than left to work it out alone. John leads without wanting to, grieving Sarah and increasingly unwilling to hear any plan that ends in anything except Setrakus Ra's death.
